concept: Delivering a difficult message to a team (a setback, a change of plan) honestly and constructively
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student, as a group leader, must tell the team about a real setback (a lost competition, a canceled plan, a resource shortfall)
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to frame and deliver the news

assessment.success_marker: student's draft is honest about the setback while still pointing toward what's next
